verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee lets developers avoid managing scraping infrastructure (headless browsers, proxies) and offers a JS-scenario DSL, extraction rules, and CLI scheduling/crawling — but this is a constrained instruction/DSL model, not a platform for deploying arbitrary custom serverless scripts (no code upload, actor/function deployment, or custom runtime evidenced). missing for 10: evidence of deploying arbitrary custom code/scripts on the platform (vs. fixed API parameters/DSL), a serverless script hosting/runtime model, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
